limitations: Measures already-available chain data read and normalization into memory, not fresh durable indexing.
Source cache is uncontrolled across repetitions; record environment and warm/cold state externally.
Version strings are declared provenance; this runner does not independently attest binaries.
Reference correctness depends on independently validated provenance; checksums only detect changed input.
Shielded compact projection only: txids exclude transactions absent from the declared compact projection; this does not prove full transaction completeness.
phase: full-range warmup and correctness check; excluded from measured distribution
timing_boundary: chain-data read + normalization to memory; excludes reference verification and all durable DB ingestion
